about: One scripted match with mistakes in the game server's code, played on the Node runner (test/node/runner-parity.test.ts) and in Zaisma's sandbox (test/rooms/sandbox-parity.test.ts). Both must answer the same messages and log the same errors by code and field, never by text.

steps.note: room.broadcast with a delivery it doesn't take throws in the handler: nothing is sent
a handler answering 5 leaves the state as it was
canJoin answering nothing turns the player away
